decisions: 4.both.1: the session registry now records a wiki session only after openTracked reports that its menu physically landed. A newer open that is refused therefore never installs or removes anything, leaving the still-visible earlier menu registered for chance-ready refreshes.

A successful older callback cannot replace a physically newer session: sessions.compute compares the landed epoch against the registered session's current menu epoch and keeps the newer one. A session that fails to land, including a stale world read, is not registered at all.

Config and MenuState are still captured before loadedWorlds, so a stale read cannot re-capture or hijack a later menu state. Existing close, reload, replacement, paging, and epoch guards are unchanged.

Added an inverse open/world-read regression to Phase9WikiOpenRaceProofTest: hold the first menu open, hold the second world read, release the first menu, complete the second read, click the visible list into its loot page, publish chances, and require the in-place refresh.

Retained 1.both.1 always/no-calculating, 1.both.2 corrected source:id missing behavior, the changing-source exactly-one-resolution proof, missing-back action, refused/exceptional/paged opens, and both failed-open regressions.
